title: finding(scripts): `check-lint-coverage.mjs:112` spells a closing keyword immediately before its ledger anchor's number — the same shape objectui#7265's ruling A just removed one gate over
body:
Dedup keywords: `check-lint-coverage` · closing keyword · stale-entry message · DEBT issue anchor · quoted gate output

Surfaced by the `os-dev` seat delivering the FINAL slice of objectui#7265 (PR objectui#9535); **re-derived on disk** by the `domain:ui` execution seat before filing. ⛔ Unassigned and ungraded.

## The reading

`scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs:112`, at `origin/main`:

```js
`${DEBT[name].issue ? ` (and close #${DEBT[name].issue} if it is done)` : ""}.`
```

⇒ a GitHub **closing keyword immediately before an interpolated issue number**, inside a message a contributor is meant to **quote** — which is the exact shape PR objectui#9535 just removed from `check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs:2044` under ruling **A**.

## Why it matters, and why it is not urgent

The hazard: the gate's discipline is to take the **intermediate reading** (the site edited, the ledger not yet regenerated) and quote it as proof the edit reached the symbol. Quoting a reading that spells `close #N` puts a **card-closing trigger in the merge path**.

⛔ **There is no live hazard today.** `scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs:54` reads `const DEBT = {};` — the ledger is **empty**, so `DEBT[name].issue` is never reached and the message never renders.

⚠️ **It becomes live the moment that ledger gains an entry** — and an entry is added precisely when someone is doing the work whose reading they would then quote.

## ⛔ Why PR objectui#9535 did not fix it

Recorded because it is the question a reviewer asks next, and the reasoning is sound: **different gate, different ledger, outside the site the dispatch named**, and a repair there would owe its own verification surface — lit controls in both directions on a message that cannot currently render — which objectui#7265 does not own. ⇒ surfaced rather than folded in.

## The fix, if taken

The same one ruling **A** took: keep the instruction, lose the keyword. PR objectui#9535's form is the worked precedent — `, and objectui#7265 can be ended once the ledger is empty` — and it is pinned there with a keyword-immediately-before-reference scan carrying lit controls **both** directions (the scan fires on the pre-reword form and is silent on the post-reword one).

⚠️ Whoever takes it should sweep for the shape rather than fix the one line: this is now the **third** instance found in `scripts/` (this one, `check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs`'s rule-2 message, and its `CLAIM_DEBT` twin at `:2197`, which is a documented deliberate exclusion).

## Related

- objectui#7265 / PR objectui#9535 — ruling A, the worked precedent and its pin.
- `check-spec-symbol-derivation.mjs:2197` — the `CLAIM_DEBT_ISSUE` twin, deliberately excluded and documented as such at `:866-870`. ⛔ Not this card.
